dedupe_keys.name: north carolina deq other permitted solid waste facilities compost transfer incinerator medical waste and tyre sites

description: This map layer lists the active solid waste facilities in North Carolina that are not landfills and that renew a permit with the state. It is maintained by the Solid Waste Section of the North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality and published on the state's NC OneMap open data hub as an ArcGIS feature service. Facility types are compost sites, household hazardous waste sites, incinerators, medical waste facilities, tyre processing sites and transfer stations. Each point carries the permit identifier and name, address, city, county, primary waste type, permit status (active, inactive and closed, or inactive and permitted), permit expiry date where known and an open or closed flag. A companion layer covers permitted landfills, open and closed. Coverage is statewide and the layer is updated as needed. It is free to view and download online in the usual hub formats and through the feature service API; the metadata carries a liability disclaimer and names no licence. Caveats: the operation type field is a regulatory code and not the real operation, and permit dates are sometimes missing. Simulation uses: locations of transfer and treatment nodes for waste collection networks and hazard exposure screening in North Carolina. Related records: the Texas facility data files (data-tceq-msw-facility-data-files) and the Arkansas permitted facilities (data-arkansas-deq-permitted-solid-waste-facilities) are comparable state registers.
